question: What is another common name for prenatal care?
explanation: Prenatal care is widely referred to as antenatal care, representing health services provided during the period of pregnancy. [learn more](GNS226_U1_T006#GNS226_U1_T006_h1)

question: Why do we encourage pregnant women to start their clinic visits (antenatal care) early?

options.A: To detect and manage potential complications early
options.B: To determine the exact sex of the baby immediately
options.C: To guarantee a completely pain-free delivery
options.D: To eliminate all normal physiological changes

explanation: Starting clinic visits early helps you spot risks and treat them before they turn into severe problems. You've got this! [learn more](GNS226_U1_T006#GNS226_U1_T006_h1)

question: How many total antenatal visits does the World Health Organization recommend for a normal, healthy pregnancy?
explanation: Global health guidelines recommend a minimum of eight antenatal visits so moms and babies get optimal monitoring and support throughout the journey. [learn more](GNS226_U1_T006#GNS226_U1_T006_h2)

question: A pregnant woman comes in for her first booking visit at 10 weeks. What is the main purpose of this early visit?

options.B: To prepare the mother for immediate labor
options.C: To measure the baby's exact birth weight
options.D: To establish a baseline health assessment

explanation: This first visit lets us record vital signs, medical history, and early lab findings so we know her normal state of health. [learn more](GNS226_U1_T006#GNS226_U1_T006_h2)

question: What naturally happens to a pregnant woman's blood (plasma) volume during normal gestation?
explanation: Plasma volume expands greatly during pregnancy to supply the placenta and keep up with the body's new demands. Amazing how the body adapts! [learn more](GNS226_U1_T006#GNS226_U1_T006_h3)

question: Why do pregnant women often complain of mild heartburn and constipation?

options.A: The kidneys stop producing gastric acid

explanation: Pregnancy hormones relax smooth muscles, which slows down digestion. This is a very normal cause of everyday heartburn and constipation! [learn more](GNS226_U1_T006#GNS226_U1_T006_h3)

question: In the common obstetric history acronym TPAL, what does the letter 'P' stand for?
explanation: In TPAL, P stands for preterm births—deliveries that happen before 37 completed weeks of pregnancy. [learn more](GNS226_U1_T006#GNS226_U1_T006_h4)

question: A woman's last menstrual period began on January 1st. Using Naegele's rule, what is her estimated date of delivery (EDD)?
explanation: Easy trick: add 7 days to the first day of the last period, then subtract 3 months. Jan 1st + 7 days = Jan 8th, minus 3 months = October 8th! [learn more](GNS226_U1_T006#GNS226_U1_T006_h4)

question: Which routine test is done at antenatal clinics to screen for gestational diabetes or kidney issues?
explanation: Testing urine samples at every visit is a quick way to spot early signs of gestational diabetes or high blood pressure in pregnancy. [learn more](GNS226_U1_T006#GNS226_U1_T006_h5)

question: Why is checking the Rhesus factor so important during the first antenatal booking visit?

options.B: To prevent maternal-fetal blood incompatibility reactions
options.C: To determine the mother's daily caloric requirement
options.D: To calculate the exact birth weight of the baby

explanation: Finding Rhesus-negative mothers early lets us give them anti-D injections to keep both mother and baby safe from blood reactions. [learn more](GNS226_U1_T006#GNS226_U1_T006_h5)

question: What is the main reason we give folic acid supplements to women in early pregnancy?
explanation: Folic acid taken before and during early pregnancy helps protect the baby's developing brain and spinal cord. Super important vitamin! [learn more](GNS226_U1_T006#GNS226_U1_T006_h6)

question: Why are iron supplements routinely given during antenatal care?

options.A: To increase the speed of fetal bone mineralization
options.C: To reduce the frequency of Braxton Hicks contractions
options.D: To support the massive expansion of maternal blood volume

explanation: Because a pregnant woman's blood volume increases so much, she needs extra iron to make enough hemoglobin and prevent anemia. [learn more](GNS226_U1_T006#GNS226_U1_T006_h6)

question: Which of these symptoms is a classic danger sign that could mean a pregnant woman is developing pre-eclampsia?

options.A: Mild swelling of the fingers in the morning

explanation: Severe headaches and changes in vision are big red flags for dangerously high blood pressure (pre-eclampsia). Always take this seriously! [learn more](GNS226_U1_T006#GNS226_U1_T006_h7)

question: A patient at 32 weeks reports she has not felt her baby move all day. What should the nurse suspect?

options.C: Standard weight gain in the third trimester
options.D: Normal resting behavior of a mature fetus

explanation: Whenever a mom says baby's movements have stopped or slowed right down, treat it as an emergency and check the baby right away. [learn more](GNS226_U1_T006#GNS226_U1_T006_h7)

question: What is the main goal of birth preparedness and complication readiness in pregnancy?

options.A: To eliminate the need for routine antenatal visits
options.B: To choose the exact time and date of labor
options.C: To remove delays in accessing emergency obstetric care
options.D: To guarantee a home delivery without any skilled staff

explanation: Planning ahead for transport and funds helps ensure a woman gets to the hospital fast if an emergency happens. [learn more](GNS226_U1_T006#GNS226_U1_T006_h8)

question: A nurse is counseling a couple on birth preparedness. Which action is most important for them to plan before the due date?

options.A: Purchasing infant formula for immediate feeding
options.B: Deciding the baby's future career path
options.C: Buying expensive nursery furniture for the baby
options.D: Arranging reliable transportation to the health facility

explanation: Transport is key! Knowing how and when to get to the clinic prevents dangerous delays when labor starts. [learn more](GNS226_U1_T006#GNS226_U1_T006_h8)
